cases.title: 3.1, 3.0 and Swagger 2.0 are imported
cases.when: Fixture documents of each version are imported
then: 3.x natively; 2.0 converted with the conversion in the report

cases.title: Supported parameter styles serialise exactly
cases.when: Operations use every supported path, query, header and cookie style
then: The broker sends the bytes the operation declares

cases.title: Unfaithful combinations are not importable
cases.when: An operation uses a style combination the broker cannot serialise, and an unsupported auth scheme
then: Both are listed as not importable with the reason, never approximated

cases.title: Exactly one request content type per tool
cases.when: An operation offers JSON and multipart bodies
then: Review picks one; it is fixed on the route; multipart parts become capped BINARY inputs

cases.title: Responses map to output and errors
cases.when: Responses 200, two 2xx schemas, 404, 408, 429, 503, 302 and an undeclared 418, for ledger and non-ledger tools
then: 408, 429 and 5xx retryable only without a ledger

cases.title: Pagination is never followed automatically
then: The tool takes a cursor input and returns one page and the next cursor

cases.title: Exactly one auth alternative per operation
then: Review picks exactly one; it becomes the route credential binding

cases.title: Imported operations default to UNKNOWN
cases.when: An unsigned document has x-toolgate-effect READ_ONLY, and a signed publisher package has the same
then: Signed: READ_ONLY, shown in review as a security delta

cases.title: The source and transformation report are stored
cases.when: A document is imported, then a new version re-imported
then: openapi/source.* and transform-report.json are in the package
Re-import produces a classified semantic diff

cases.title: cURL import produces the same package shape
then: An OPENAPI package with one tool and a report
